sources.title: d1-2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: d1-2B is designed for any pipeline step that needs a decision: routing and triage, moderation and guardrails, intent and topic classification, extraction from documents and forms, judging and reranking, and visual inspection. It is not a chat model. Knowledge-heavy questions favor larger models, and answers get less reliable past about 64K tokens of state.

sources.title: Introducing d1: The most capable decision model, now with vision
sources.snippet: d1, Liquid AI's decision model, now handles text and images. It matches or beats GPT-6.1 Sol on 4 of 6 real tasks.
